This is a resource-limiting issue: `deploy.resources.limits.memory` causes cgroup creation with specific settings. Actually the error is about domain controllers and threaded mode. Possibly the compose applies cgroup parent "docker" and something. hello-world worked fine, so basic container creation works. The difference might be the memory limits in deploy.resources.limits.

Let me try `docker run --rm -m 512m hello-world`.

Actually the issue might be with multiple containers starting simultaneously. Let me test with memory limit.
